zhDesc: 泡沫年代录音棚里堆出来的高保真软摇滚，滑顺的电钢、切分吉他和一线乐手的贝斯线，唱的都是夜间高速、海滨公路和不会兑现的约会。
enDesc: Bubble-era Tokyo studio pop: glossy electric piano, chicken-scratch guitar, session-grade basslines, all pointed at night drives and coastal highways.

zhDesc: 唱片店店员做出来的音乐，法国香颂、六十年代电影配乐和 bossa nova 的碎片被拼成甜腻的拼贴，编曲精致到像橱窗陈设。
enDesc: Record-store-clerk pop from Shibuya: French chanson, sixties soundtracks and bossa nova cut up into sweet, boutique-precise collages.

zhDesc: 战后唱片工业的主干，西洋管弦与爵士和声套在日语旋律上，编曲豪华、唱腔端正，是演歌与流行分家之前的中间地带。
enDesc: Postwar Japanese record-industry pop: Western orchestras and jazz harmony under Japanese melody, before enka and J-pop split apart.

zhDesc: 颤音拖得极长的悲情演唱，五声音阶配上弦乐与三味线，唱港口、雪国、酒和留不住的人，眼泪都在唱法的转折处。
enDesc: Heavy-vibrato Japanese torch singing over pentatonic strings and shamisen: harbours, snow country, sake and people who left.

whereZh: 日本 · 青森 · 传统
zhDesc: 北国盲人艺人乞食街头留下的粗犷奏法，拨子重砸琴皮，打击与旋律同出一手，即兴段落越比越狠，像刀锋刮过雪面。
enDesc: Percussive northern Japanese lute style from blind itinerant players: the plectrum slams the skin, improvised passages turn into duels.

whereZh: 日本 · 冲绳 · 传统
zhDesc: 蛇皮三线弹出独特的琉球音阶，缺了两个音于是听着既明亮又悬空，唱段配着拍手与尖锐的呼喊，喜庆里藏着战后的伤。
enDesc: Snakeskin sanshin and the gapped Ryukyuan scale: bright yet unresolved songs, hand claps and piercing calls, wartime grief under the festivity.

zhDesc: 禅僧当作修行的独奏竹笛曲，一口气就是一个乐句，气声、滑音和长静默比音高更重要，听上去更像呼吸而非旋律。
enDesc: Solo bamboo-flute pieces played as Zen practice: one breath per phrase, where breath noise, bends and silence matter more than pitch.
key: Watazumi Doso — Mysterious Sounds of the Japanese Bamboo Flute

whereZh: 日本 · 宫廷 · 传统
zhDesc: 千年未断的宫廷合奏，笙撑出静止的和音层，篳篥在上面极慢地弯音，鼓点相隔数秒落下，时间几乎被拉平。
enDesc: Millennium-old Japanese court ensemble: shō mouth-organ drones, hichiriki reeds bending slowly above, drum strokes seconds apart.
key: Kyoto Imperial Court Music Orchestra — Gagaku: Ancient Japanese Court Music

zhDesc: 一个歌者一个鼓手撑起数小时的叙事长篇，嗓子练到刻意沙哑破裂，唱念交替，鼓手在缝隙里插进吆喝助兴。
enDesc: Hours-long Korean epic narrative for one singer and one drummer: deliberately roughened voice alternating song and speech, drummer shouting encouragement.

zhDesc: 为伽倻琴或玄鹤琴写的独奏组曲，从极慢的板式一路加速到密集的收尾，弦被推弯出颤抖的余音，鼓只在骨节处应答。
enDesc: Korean solo zither suites that accelerate from a near-static opening to a dense finish, strings pushed into quavering bends, drum answering at the joints.

zhDesc: 把农乐的露天游行搬上舞台的四件打击乐，小锣、鼓、长鼓与大锣层层错位，节拍循环反复推挤，听久了像被卷进漩涡。
enDesc: Four Korean percussion instruments moved from village processions onto the stage: interlocking gongs and drums, cycles pushing until the pulse becomes a vortex.

zhDesc: 踩着二拍子的老派韩国流行，手风琴和电子琴摇摆着走，唱腔带滑音与哭腔，是酒席、长途巴士和中年人的点歌单。
enDesc: Old-school Korean pop on a duple shuffle: accordion and organ swinging, sobbing vocal slides, the songbook of banquets and long bus rides.

whereZh: 中国 · 广东 · 传统
zhDesc: 高胯子嗓与椰胡、秦琴、锣鼓一同上行，念白与唱段之间靠板眼衔接，二十世纪的戏班还把小提琴与萨克斯搬上了台。
enDesc: High-strung Cantonese singing over coconut fiddle, plucked lutes and clattering gongs; twentieth-century troupes also dragged violin and saxophone onstage.

whereZh: 中国 · 泉州与台湾 · 传统
zhDesc: 泉州一带留下的极慢室内乐，横抱的琵琶、洞箫与拍板托着女声，一个字能唱出好几拍，听着像宋元的语速还没改过来。
enDesc: Extremely slow chamber song from Quanzhou: horizontally held pipa, end-blown flute and clappers behind a voice that stretches one syllable over bars.
key: Tsai Hsiao-Yueh — Nan-kouan: Chant courtois de la Chine du Sud

whereZh: 中国 · 江浙沪 · 传统
zhDesc: 茶馆里几位熟人围坐，二胡、笛、琵琶、扬琴各自给同一条骨干旋律加花，谁多绕一圈别人就让一让，热闹却不抢。
enDesc: Teahouse chamber music from the Yangtze delta: fiddle, flute, pipa and hammered zither each ornament the same skeletal tune, weaving without collision.

zhDesc: 七弦琴独奏，音量小得几乎只够弹给自己听，泛音、按滑与指甲擦弦的杂音都算内容，乐句之间的空白比音更长。
enDesc: Solo seven-string zither played almost too quietly to share: harmonics, sliding stops and fingernail scrape all count, silences longer than the notes.

whereZh: 蒙古与内蒙古 · 传统
zhDesc: 一句歌词能拉开几十秒，嗓子在高音区连续做细密装饰，马头琴在下面若有若无地跟着，像草原上望不到边的地平线。
enDesc: One line of text stretched across half a minute, the voice ornamenting high in its range while horsehead fiddle trails behind like an endless horizon.

whereZh: 俄罗斯 · 图瓦 · 传统
zhDesc: 一个人同时发出低音持续与上方哨状泛音，模仿的是马蹄、风与河水，配上弓弦乐器与马蹄节奏，牧歌里带着金属光。
enDesc: One throat producing a low drone plus whistling overtones, imitating hooves, wind and river, set against bowed fiddles and a riding pulse.

whereZh: 西藏与流亡寺院 · 传统
zhDesc: 僧人用超低的喉音齐诵，每个人嗓子里同时响出基音与和音，长号与铙钹偶尔炸开一下，声音贴着地面铺过来。
enDesc: Monks chanting in impossibly low multiphonic voices, each throat sounding a chord at once, long horns and cymbals erupting through the floor-level drone.
key: The Gyuto Monks — Tibetan Tantric Choir

zhDesc: 把陕北信天游的高腔嗓子塞进合成器与电鼓的八十年代内地流行，唱黄土、出走与不甘，粗声大气得像对着山谷喊。
enDesc: Late-eighties mainland pop that dropped Shaanxi highland holler vocals onto synths and drum machines: loess, leaving home, shouting at a valley.

zhDesc: 农村听众的点唱主力，唱腔满是慢颤音与滑音，伴奏却是电风琴、铜管和拉丁节奏，题材永远绕着离乡进城打工。
enDesc: Thailand's rural hit music: heavily bent, slow-vibrato vocals over farfisa organ, brass and Latin rhythms, forever about leaving the village for the city.
key: V/A — The Sound of Siam: Leftfield Luk Thung, Jazz & Molam from Thailand 1964–75

whereZh: 泰国 · 伊森与老挝 · 传统至 1970s
zhDesc: 老挝语系的说唱式吟唱，khaen 竹排笙一路不停吹持续和声，歌手押韵斗嘴、连珠炮似地推进，后来接上电贝斯就更催。
enDesc: Lao-language rhyming chant driven by the khaen mouth-organ drone: singers duel in rapid-fire verse, later plugged into electric bass and drums.

zhDesc: 学生运动年代长出来的抗议民谣，木吉他与泰式笛子并排，歌词替农民和水牛说话，曾被军政府查禁，后来成了大学生宿舍里的经典。
enDesc: Thai protest folk born from the seventies student movement: acoustic guitars beside reed flutes, songs for farmers and buffalo, once banned outright.

zhDesc: 美军电台带来的冲浪吉他与灵魂乐节奏，被套上高棉旋律与颤抖的女声，录音在赤柬到来前中断，留下的母带没剩几盘。
enDesc: Surf guitar and soul grooves off American forces radio, wrapped in Khmer melody and quavering female vocals, cut short when the Khmer Rouge arrived.
key: Ros Serey Sothea — "Chnam Oun Dop-Chet Chnam"

whereZh: 柬埔寨 · 宫廷与寺院 · 传统
zhDesc: 为宫廷舞与影偶戏伴奏的排琴与锣组，硬槌敲出闪亮的颗粒，双簧管在上方滑行，鼓与拍板把整套编制钉在一条缓慢的循环上。
enDesc: Khmer court ensemble of tuned xylophones and gong circles behind masked dance: glittering hard-mallet attacks, a reed gliding above, drums pinning the cycle.
key: V/A — Music of Cambodia Vol. 2: Royal Court Music

zhDesc: 葡萄牙水手留下的小吉他在爪哇变成一对互咬的拨弦，大提琴用手拨当鼓点，长笛绕着女声打转，摇晃得像旧留声机。
enDesc: Portuguese sailors' small guitars reborn in Java as interlocking plucked patterns, pizzicato cello as drum, flute circling a wavering voice.

zhDesc: 名字就来自手鼓那两声「当—嘟」，印度电影歌的滑音、马来班顿与摇滚吉他挤在一起，是集市与竞选舞台上最响的东西。
enDesc: Named after its two drum strokes: Bollywood-style vocal slides, Malay song forms and rock guitar, the loudest thing at any Indonesian market or rally.

zhDesc: 巽他鼓手把村里舞乐改成炸裂的独奏语言，kendang 突然抽拍、猛砸、留白，女声在上面盘旋，舞者只能盯着鼓走。
enDesc: Sundanese drummers rebuilt village dance music as explosive solo language: kendang cutting, slamming and dropping out while a woman's voice circles above.

zhDesc: 整团青铜乐器同时爆出一击再骤然收住，成对调音让音色抖动不止，快段落由两组交错敲出，速度比单人手速更快。
enDesc: A whole bronze orchestra flashing on one stroke then cutting dead; paired detuning makes the tone shimmer, interlocking parts outrun any single pair of hands.
key: V/A — The Roots of Gamelan: The First Recordings, Bali 1928

whereZh: 越南 · 北部 · 传统
zhDesc: 女歌者一手敲小竹板，三弦琴稀疏应和，鼓客用一记鼓点当评语；唱腔咬字极紧，颤音像喉咙里含着一根细线。
enDesc: A woman singer clacking bamboo sticks, a three-string lute answering sparsely, a listener's drum stroke as critique; taut diction, wire-thin vibrato.
key: Quách Thị Hồ — Vietnam: Ca Trù & Quan Ho (UNESCO Collection)

zhDesc: 西贡时代的慢板情歌，bolero 节奏配电风琴与弦乐，男声带哭腔地唱边城、离别与等不到的信，战后被禁多年仍靠翻录流传。
enDesc: Saigon-era slow ballads on a bolero lilt: organ, strings and sobbing male voices singing garrison towns and letters that never came; banned for decades.

zhDesc: 三拍子的他加禄语求爱歌，前半段小调后半段转大调，表面唱女子，殖民年代里大家都听得出唱的是国家。
enDesc: Triple-meter Tagalog courtship song that turns from minor to major halfway: ostensibly to a woman, understood under colonial rule as a song to the nation.

zhDesc: 马科斯戒严年代的轻快本地流行，软摇滚与灵魂乐底子上唱起街头菲式英语混搭，歌词笑嘻嘻地写通勤、追女生和吃饭。
enDesc: Breezy local pop from martial-law Manila: soft-rock and soul grooves with cheerful Taglish lyrics about commuting, crushes and where to eat.

zhDesc: 船形弯琴 saung 与歌者互相追逐，琴弦调得松，音一出来就往下垂，拍板点出不规则的强弱，旋律听着总像刚要落地又飘开。
enDesc: The boat-shaped Burmese harp chasing a singer over slack strings that sag as they sound, bell and clapper marking an off-kilter beat.
key: Inle Myint Maung & Yi Yi Thant — Mahāgīta: Harp and Vocal Music of Burma

whereZh: 印度与孟加拉 · 孟加拉地区 · 传统
zhDesc: 不属任何教派的游方歌者，一手弹单弦 ektara，脚踝系铃铛，歌词用身体与河流比喻神，边走边唱，嗓子沙得像风吹过芦苇。
enDesc: Wandering Bengali mystics outside every sect: one-string ektara, ankle bells, songs using body and river as metaphors for god, voices raw as reed wind.
key: Purna Das Baul — The Bauls of Bengal

whereZh: 印度 · 拉贾斯坦沙漠 · 传统
zhDesc: 沙漠里的世袭乐师家族，替资助的贵族家唱婚丧与家谱，kamaicha 弓弦低吟，khartal 木板打得极碎，嗓门横着推出去。
enDesc: Hereditary desert musicians singing weddings, deaths and patrons' genealogies: growling kamaicha fiddle, clattering wooden khartal, voices pushed wide open.

zhDesc: 北印古典里最放得开的抒情体裁，一句情话可以翻着花腔唱十分钟，规矩让位给语气，听的是歌者怎么把一个字揉软。
enDesc: The most pliant lyric form in Hindustani classical: a single line of longing spun for ten minutes, rules giving way to how a syllable is bent.
key: Bade Ghulam Ali Khan — "Yaad Piya Ki Aaye"

zhDesc: 北印古典中最古老最朴素的一支，没有花俏装饰，先用无节拍的长段把一个调的骨架慢慢立起来，pakhawaj 鼓晚半小时才进来。
enDesc: The oldest, austerest branch of Hindustani music: no filigree, a vast unmetered exposition raising the raga's skeleton before the pakhawaj drum enters.
key: Ustad Zia Mohiuddin Dagar — Raga Yaman

zhDesc: 孟买配乐棚里把摩格合成器、瓦瓦吉他和迪斯科弦乐塞进歌舞场面，印度旋律照唱，底下的槽却是当年最时髦的舞池节奏。
enDesc: Bombay soundtrack rooms loading Moog, wah guitar and disco strings under dance numbers: Indian melody on top, the decade's hottest groove beneath.

zhDesc: 巴基斯坦影业的配乐棚风格，乌尔都语情歌上叠电风琴、失真吉他与手鼓，预算紧、混音生猛，粗糙处反而成了它的招牌。
enDesc: Pakistani film-studio pop: Urdu love songs over cheap organ, distorted guitar and tabla, mixed hot on tiny budgets until the roughness became the sound.
key: V/A — The Sound of Wonder! (Pakistani film music, Finders Keepers)

zhDesc: 把古典诗的对句唱成半即兴的独唱，harmonium 与 sarangi 只在底下托着，歌者把同一句词换好几种腔反复唱，留出的停顿正好给听众叹气。
enDesc: Classical Urdu couplets sung half-improvised over harmonium and sarangi, the singer recasting one line several ways and pausing for the audience's sigh.

whereZh: 巴基斯坦 · 旁遮普与信德 · 传统
zhDesc: 唱布雷沙等苏菲诗人的旁遮普语诗，一句叠句反复上推直到嗓子撕开，手鼓与 harmonium 跟着加速，属于圣墓前的通宵场合。
enDesc: Punjabi verses of Sufi poets like Bulleh Shah, a refrain pushed upward until the voice tears, tabla and harmonium accelerating at all-night shrine gatherings.

zhDesc: 大型阿拉伯管弦为独唱者铺路，一首能唱一小时，歌者反复回到同一句上加花，台下听众的喝彩本身就是乐曲的一部分。
enDesc: Large Arabic orchestras clearing the way for one singer across an hour, returning again and again to one line while the audience's cries become part of the piece.

whereZh: 叙利亚 · 阿勒颇 · 传统
zhDesc: 阿勒颇的老城歌本，宗教与世俗歌词共用同一批曲调，男声合唱与独唱轮替，拍子突然转换，听得出苏菲聚会里的身体摆动。
enDesc: Aleppo's old-city songbook where sacred and secular texts share tunes: soloist alternating with male chorus, meters switching, Sufi sway audible underneath.

whereZh: 摩洛哥与阿尔及利亚 · 传统
zhDesc: 摩尔人被逐出伊比利亚后带走的组曲传统，一套按固定节奏序列从慢到快走完，齐唱与 rebab、乌德交错，规模大得像一场仪式。
enDesc: Suite tradition carried out of Iberia by exiled Moors: fixed rhythmic movements running slow to fast, unison chorus trading with rebab and oud.
key: Ustad Massano Tazi — Musique classique andalouse de Fès

whereZh: 阿尔及利亚 · 阿尔及尔老城 · 1930s–70s
zhDesc: 老城咖啡馆里长出的市井歌乐，mandole 领奏，段落越走越急，唱移民、赌运与酒，后来成了巴黎阿尔及利亚人乡愁的声音。
enDesc: Casbah café music led by the mandole, sections gathering speed across a long song about migration, luck and drink — later the anthem of Algerians in Paris.

zhDesc: 撒哈拉以南奴隶后裔的通灵仪式乐，三弦低音琴 guembri 顶着铁响板 qraqeb，整夜按颜色分段推进，把人推到出神为止。
enDesc: Trance ritual music of Moroccans descended from sub-Saharan slaves: booming three-string guembri under iron qraqeb, all-night suites ordered by colour.
key: Maleem Mahmoud Ghania with Pharoah Sanders — The Trance of Seven Colors

zhDesc: 婚礼现场把踏步舞曲交给一台调过音准的电子琴，模仿 mijwiz 芦笛的尖锐音色狂扫，主唱在扩音器里吼着现编的祝词。
enDesc: Wedding dabke handed to one retuned keyboard imitating shrieking mijwiz reeds, while the singer bellows improvised blessings straight into the PA.
key: Omar Souleyman — Highway to Hassake: Folk and Pop Sounds of Syria

zhDesc: 师徒口传的曲目体系，一套 dastgāh 按规定次序展开，santur 或 tar 与歌者一句一句应答，几乎没有固定节拍，全靠呼吸。
enDesc: An orally transmitted repertoire unfolding a dastgāh in fixed order: santur or tar answering the singer phrase by phrase, pulse governed only by breath.
key: Mohammad Reza Shajarian & Parviz Meshkatian — Bidad

zhDesc: 歌者一手摇着框鼓，tar 与 kamancha 在旁托着，情绪层层往上顶，到高处近乎呜咽，中间插进短小的固定歌调喘口气。
enDesc: A singer beating a frame drum while tar and kamancha hold the ground, emotion climbing toward a near-sob, brief fixed songs dropped in to breathe.
key: Alim & Fargana Qasimov — Spiritual Music of Azerbaijan

zhDesc: 进城打工者的哭腔流行，阿拉伯式弦乐群与 bağlama 加上电吉他，歌词全是被骗、被抛下与命不好，被精英骂了几十年。
enDesc: Weeping pop of Turkey's rural migrants: Arabic-style string swells, bağlama and electric guitar behind lyrics of betrayal and bad fate, scorned by elites.

whereZh: 土耳其 · 伊斯坦布尔 · 1970s
zhDesc: 把民谣的微分音旋律交给加了效果器的电吉他和电 saz，鼓组照西方摇滚打，结果既是摇滚又保留了村里舞曲的不对称拍。
enDesc: Folk melodies with their microtonal bends handed to fuzzed guitar and electric saz over a Western rock kit, village dance meters left crooked.

whereZh: 土耳其 · 安纳托利亚 · 传统
zhDesc: 自弹 saz 自唱的游吟诗人，讲道理也讲故事，还常两人对垒即兴押韵；曲调朴素到几乎只剩说话的起伏，重量全在词上。
enDesc: Anatolian bards accompanying themselves on saz, preaching and storytelling and duelling in improvised rhyme, melodies stripped to speech contour.

whereZh: 乌兹别克与塔吉克 · 布哈拉 · 传统
zhDesc: 布哈拉宫廷与犹太乐师共同守住的六套大曲，从器乐段进入声乐段，音区一路往上爬，到顶点时嗓子几乎绷断。
enDesc: Six courtly suites kept alive by Bukharan Muslim and Jewish musicians alike: instrumental sections giving way to vocal cycles that climb until the voice strains.
key: V/A — Bukhara: Musical Crossroads of Asia

whereZh: 中国 · 新疆 · 传统
zhDesc: 长达数小时的组曲，从自由吟唱开头，逐步接入 satar 长颈弓弦与手鼓的舞段，节拍越换越密，最后变成整村跟着跳。
enDesc: Hours-long Uyghur suites opening in free recitation, then folding in long-necked satar and frame drums as meters tighten into village-wide dancing.

whereZh: 吉尔吉斯斯坦 · 传统
zhDesc: 三弦无品琴的独奏小品，乐手边弹边把琴翻转抛接，旋律模拟马步与鸟叫，一段器乐曲往往附带一整个传说。
enDesc: Solo pieces for the fretless three-string komuz, flipped and tossed mid-performance, melodies imitating horse gaits and birds, each tune carrying a legend.
key: Tengir-Too — Music of Central Asia Vol. 1: Mountain Music of Kyrgyzstan

whereZh: 塔吉克斯坦 · 巴达赫尚 · 传统
zhDesc: 帕米尔山区的哀歌体，唱命运与离别，嗓子拉到极高再往下滑，rubab 与框鼓稀疏应答，常在葬礼与长夜聚会上唱。
enDesc: Pamiri lament on fate and separation: the voice hauled to its ceiling then slid down, rubab and frame drum answering sparsely at funerals and long nights.
key: V/A — Music of Central Asia Vol. 5: The Badakhshan Ensemble

zhDesc: 酒棚里一把吉他一个手鼓的松散唱段，指法是水手带来的葡语弹法与本地节奏对上的产物，速度慢、话多、笑点也多。
enDesc: One guitar, one hand drum and a long loose song in a drinking bar: sailors' Lusophone fingerpicking married to coastal rhythm, slow, chatty and wry.
key: S.E. Rogie — Palm Wine Guitar Music: The 60's Sound

zhDesc: 移居德国的加纳乐手用多轨棚和合成器重做高生活，吉他线路照旧交错，底下换成打点清亮的电鼓，气味介于阿克拉与迪斯科。
enDesc: Ghanaian musicians in Germany rebuilt highlife with synths and multitrack: the interlocking guitars stayed, the bottom became crisp drum machine and disco sheen.

zhDesc: 从斋月唤醒歌发展成的纯打击乐流派，一堆会说话的鼓与铁片，没有和弦乐器，主唱靠夸赞与斗嘴撑起一整面，现场能开到通宵。
enDesc: Grown from Ramadan wake-up songs into an all-percussion style: talking drums and iron bells, no chords, a praise-singer carrying whole sides till dawn.

whereZh: 尼日利亚 · 约鲁巴地区 · 1950s–70s
zhDesc: 手鼓与拇指琴般的金属摩擦声配上低沉的约鲁巴语劝世词，速度不快但拍子极黏，唱的是道德、人情与社交场上的谁欠谁。
enDesc: Yoruba hand drums and scraped metal under low proverbial singing: unhurried but sticky rhythm, lyrics weighing morals, favours and social debts.

whereZh: 埃塞俄比亚 · 亚的斯亚贝巴 · 1960s–70s
zhDesc: 把埃塞俄比亚五声调式塞进爵士与拉丁编制，颤音琴与管乐吹出偏斜的音阶，听着既像纽约后台也像亚的斯的夜总会。
enDesc: Ethiopian pentatonic modes loaded into jazz and Latin arrangements: vibraphone and horns leaning on skewed scales, half New York, half Addis nightclub.
key: Mulatu Astatke — Éthiopiques 4: Ethio Jazz & Musique Instrumentale

whereZh: 埃塞俄比亚 · 传统至 1990s
zhDesc: 酒馆里的即兴歌手，拉着单弦 masenqo 或弹 krar，词是当场编的双关与讽刺，谁给钱就唱谁，也顺便把政治藏在情话里。
enDesc: Tavern improvisers on one-string masenqo or krar, inventing punning satire on the spot, flattering whoever pays and hiding politics inside love talk.
key: V/A — Éthiopiques 2: Tètchawèt! Urban Azmaris of the 90's

whereZh: 撒哈拉 · 马里与阿尔及利亚 · 1980s 起
zhDesc: 流亡营地里靠电吉他与手鼓写成的歌，循环乐句慢慢咬住不放，合唱与拍手垫底，唱思乡、枪与骆驼道上的漫长等待。
enDesc: Songs written in exile camps on electric guitar and hand drum: circling riffs that refuse to resolve, chorused answers, homesickness, rifles, long desert waits.

zhDesc: 马里南部的女声主导传统，六弦猎人竖琴 kamale ngoni 与葫芦打击铺底，歌词直说婚姻、生育与女人的处境，嗓子不留退路。
enDesc: Woman-led tradition from southern Mali over hunters' six-string kamale ngoni and gourd percussion, lyrics naming marriage, childbearing and women's lot outright.

whereZh: 西非 · 曼德地区 · 传统
zhDesc: 世袭乐师家族掌管的历史记忆，二十一弦竖琴 kora 双手分工，右手滚花左手守骨干，唱段之间插进整段家族谱系的念诵。
enDesc: Hereditary Mande musicians holding the historical record: the 21-string kora's right hand spinning figures over a left-hand ostinato, genealogies recited between verses.

zhDesc: 沃洛夫人的鼓群，一手木棒一手手掌，鼓语能对应具体句子，众鼓齐鸣时突然停在一个空拍上，舞者就靠那一拍炸出动作。
enDesc: Wolof drum ensembles played with one stick and one hand, strokes spelling actual phrases, the whole battery stopping on an empty beat for a dancer's explosion.

zhDesc: 把贝提人木琴敲击搬到电吉他上，弦被调得又薄又脆，节拍是往地上踩的三拍循环，歌词直白得让当年的电台不太敢放。
enDesc: Beti xylophone patterns transplanted to thin, brittle electric guitar over a stamping triple-time cycle, with lyrics blunt enough to worry state radio.

zhDesc: 刚果伦巴提速后的舞厅版本，前半段唱情歌，后半段整曲交给吉他的 sebene 循环，越弹越快，吆喝声一句接一句往上垫。
enDesc: Congolese rumba sped up for the dancefloor: a sung half, then the guitar sebene taking the whole track over, accelerating under stacked shouted calls.

zhDesc: 国营乐团奉命把古老的曼德史诗改编成大编制电声乐队，管乐与双吉他齐奏 kora 的乐句，一首曲子能横跨整面唱片。
enDesc: State-funded bands ordered to rework ancient Mande epics for electric orchestra: horns and twin guitars doubling kora lines across whole LP sides.
key: Bembeya Jazz National — Regard sur le Passé

zhDesc: 把卢奥人竖琴 nyatiti 的跳跃低音搬给电吉他与贝斯，两把吉他交错跑得飞快，段落末尾转调像换了个房间。
enDesc: The leaping bass of the Luo nyatiti lyre handed to guitar and electric bass: two guitars racing in interlock, each section shifting key like changing rooms.
key: D.O. Misiani & Shirati Jazz — Benga Blast!

whereZh: 坦桑尼亚 · 桑给巴尔 · 1900s–80s
zhDesc: 印度洋港口的混血歌乐，阿拉伯乌德、埃及式弦乐群与斯瓦希里语诗并置，唱得含蓄，暗讽藏在比喻里，婚宴上一句能扎人一年。
enDesc: Indian Ocean port music: Arabic oud, Egyptian-style string section and Swahili verse, insults hidden in metaphor and aimed across the wedding hall.
key: Ikhwani Safaa Musical Club — Music of Zanzibar: Taarab 4

zhDesc: 郊区用铁丝和罐头自制吉他弹出来的舞曲，节奏轻快偏赶，唱词是葡语殖民末期的市井笑话，独立后被扩编成整支电声乐团。
enDesc: Dance music first played on guitars built from tin and wire in Maputo's suburbs: hurried, skipping rhythm and street humour, later scaled up to an electric orchestra.
key: Orchestra Marrabenta Star de Moçambique — Independance

whereZh: 津巴布韦 · 绍纳地区 · 传统
zhDesc: 装在葫芦共鸣箱里的拇指琴，金属片上串着瓶盖发出沙响，循环乐句几十分钟不变，通灵仪式上靠它把祖先的声音叫回来。
enDesc: Thumb piano in a gourd resonator, bottle caps buzzing against the keys, one cycle held for half an hour to call ancestral spirits into a possession ceremony.

zhDesc: 城镇录音棚的流水线舞曲，贝斯线粗壮跳跃，女声三重唱在上方齐唱，男主唱用极低的「咆哮」嗓插话，三分钟一首毫不拖延。
enDesc: Assembly-line township dance music: thick loping bass, a female trio harmonising above, and a groaning bass-voiced man answering, all inside three minutes.

whereZh: 南非 · 夸祖鲁 · 1970s 起
zhDesc: 祖鲁旅人吉他弹唱，指法带着 ukupika 的滚动，歌中间要插一段飞快的自我介绍式念白，报出姓氏、村名与恩怨。
enDesc: Zulu travelling guitar song with rolling ukupika picking, interrupted midway by a rapid spoken boast naming the singer's clan, village and grudges.

zhDesc: 开普敦的爵士方言，把游行队伍的 goema 节奏和教会和声塞进钢琴左手，旋律简单反复，在种族隔离年代成了半公开的国歌。
enDesc: Cape Town's jazz dialect: carnival goema rhythm and church harmony pressed into the piano's left hand, a simple repeated tune that became an underground anthem.

whereZh: 佛得角 · 圣地亚哥岛 · 传统至 1990s
zhDesc: 一台手风琴对一根刮铁片，两个人就能把舞会撑到天亮，节奏往前赶得几乎要翻掉，殖民当局嫌它太野蛮曾长期禁演。
enDesc: One accordion against one scraped iron bar keeping a dance going till dawn, the rhythm rushing forward — banned for years by colonial authorities as too crude.

zhDesc: 群岛的慢摇情歌，吉他与 cavaquinho 摆出懒散的摆荡，克里奥尔语唱的全是离岛、思念与回不去的码头，克制得不肯哭出来。
enDesc: Slow creole island song swaying on guitar and cavaquinho, every lyric about emigration and a harbour you can't return to, too restrained to actually weep.

whereZh: 法国 · 留尼汪岛 · 传统
zhDesc: 奴隶后裔的祖灵歌舞，大框鼓 roulèr 坐着敲，竹筒摇出细密沙响，领唱与合唱一来一往，拍子偏得让人第一次听会数错。
enDesc: Ancestor-summoning song and dance of Réunion's slave descendants: a seated roulèr drum, rattling bamboo, call and response over a beat that trips first-time listeners.

zhDesc: 石油小镇的舞会音乐，冲浪吉他与颤音效果器套在哥伦比亚 cumbia 的两拍上，安第斯五声旋律与电风琴互相顶，热得发潮。
enDesc: Oil-boom dance music from jungle towns: surf guitar and tremolo laid on a Colombian cumbia pulse, Andean pentatonic tunes trading with farfisa organ.

whereZh: 秘鲁与玻利维亚 · 安第斯 · 传统
zhDesc: 安第斯高原的对舞歌，竖琴或小提琴领着一个短促的跳跃节奏走，女声尖细高亢，歌词在克丘亚语与西语之间来回跳。
enDesc: Andean couple-dance song driven by harp or fiddle on a short skipping rhythm, with piercing high female voices sliding between Quechua and Spanish.
key: V/A — Huayno Music of Peru Vol. 1 (Arhoolie)

whereZh: 阿根廷 · 圣地亚哥德尔埃斯特罗 · 传统
zhDesc: 内陆干旱省份的舞歌，吉他扫弦与 bombo 大鼓踩着六拍与三拍的双重感觉，歌词混着克丘亚土语，唱干活、干旱与解闷的酒。
enDesc: Dance song from Argentina's dry interior: strummed guitar and bombo drum straddling six and three at once, lyrics salted with Quechua words.

whereZh: 古巴 · 关塔那摩 · 传统
zhDesc: 古巴东部山区的老式派对乐，tres 吉他、marímbula 低音箱与大号 bongó 咬着一个前置的重音，拍子偏得连专业乐手都数错。
enDesc: Old-style party music from Cuba's eastern hills: tres guitar, marímbula bass box and oversized bongó locked on an anticipated accent that trips trained players.
key: V/A — Changüí: The Sound of Guantánamo

zhDesc: 录音棚里深夜的即兴大会，乐手就着一个两和弦的循环轮流独奏，贝斯不停摆，一卷带子录满就算一首，爵士与舞厅在此打平。
enDesc: After-hours studio jams where players solo in turn over a two-chord vamp, bass never stopping, a take ending when the tape does.
key: Cachao — Cuban Jam Sessions in Miniature: Descargas

whereZh: 墨西哥 · 瓦斯特卡 · 传统
zhDesc: 三人小组：小提琴拉出大段炫技花腔，两把吉他一高一低垫节奏，两个男声轮流飙到假声破音，越比越高，舞者踩木板应答。
enDesc: Three players: a violin spinning virtuoso figures over high and low guitars while two men trade lines into cracking falsetto, dancers answering on a wooden platform.
key: Los Camperos de Valles — El Triunfo: Sones de la Huasteca

zhDesc: 德墨边境的舞厅编制，全音阶手风琴对上十二弦低音吉他 bajo sexto，波尔卡与华尔兹的节拍留着德国移民的印子，歌词是西语的。
enDesc: Border dancehall lineup of diatonic accordion against twelve-string bajo sexto, keeping German-immigrant polka and waltz meters under Spanish lyrics.
key: Flaco Jiménez — Ay Te Dejo en San Antonio

zhDesc: 里约的器乐炫技传统，曼陀铃或长笛跑十六分音符不歇气，七弦吉他在低音区顶着反向的对旋律，转调频繁，聚会里轮流较劲。
enDesc: Rio's instrumental virtuoso tradition: mandolin or flute running unbroken sixteenths while a seven-string guitar answers in the bass, keys changing constantly.

zhDesc: 三件乐器就够：手风琴、三角铁与 zabumba 扁鼓，节奏一摇一摆地往前推，唱干旱、迁徙与内地人的骄傲，是六月节的标配。
enDesc: Three instruments suffice — accordion, triangle and zabumba drum — rocking forward under songs of drought, migration and backlands pride at June festivals.

whereZh: 巴西 · 圣保罗与里约 · 1960s–70s
zhDesc: 黑人舞会上拿吉他右手切分去撞灵魂乐的鼓点，贝斯线学着放克走，桑巴的摇摆没丢，转身舞步靠那点错位的推进感。
enDesc: Black dance-party music where a slashing samba guitar hand meets a soul drum kit and funk bass, the swing intact and the push deliberately off-centre.

zhDesc: 牙买加最早的乡村流行，班卓、竹笛、手摇沙锤加一把土制低音，重音落在第四拍，唱的全是荤笑话与乡下八卦，比 ska 还早一辈。
enDesc: Jamaica's first rural pop: banjo, bamboo fife, rumba box and shakers accenting the fourth beat, packed with bawdy jokes a generation before ska.
key: V/A — Take Me to Jamaica: The Story of Jamaican Mento

zhDesc: ska 突然放慢下来的那两三年，管乐退场、贝斯线变成主角，和声组唱美国灵魂乐式的情歌，舞步从跳跃改成贴着地磨。
enDesc: The two or three years when ska slowed down: horns receding, bass lines taking the lead, harmony trios singing soul ballads for dancers who stopped jumping.
key: Alton Ellis — Mr. Soul of Jamaica

zhDesc: 海地舞厅的招牌节奏，鼓点平稳得像走路，萨克斯与吉他在上面绕，纽约的海地移民乐队把它加上放克贝斯又送回岛上。
enDesc: Haiti's signature dancehall groove: a walking, unhurried beat under circling saxophones and guitar, later sent home from New York with funk bass attached.

zhDesc: 把伏都仪式的鼓与颂歌接上摇滚乐队编制，鼓组三层叠着走，合唱唱神名，八十年代末在独裁末期成了街头抗争的声音。
enDesc: Vodou ceremonial drums and chants plugged into a rock band: three drum layers interlocking, choruses naming spirits, street protest music as the dictatorship fell.

zhDesc: 小亚细亚难民带到港口贫民区的歌，bouzouki 与 baglamas 拨出瘦硬的音色，唱监狱、大麻窝与穷到没辙的日子，节拍常是九拍。
enDesc: Songs of Asia Minor refugees in port slums: wiry bouzouki and baglamas behind prison, hashish-den and destitution lyrics, often in limping nine-beat meter.

zhDesc: 作曲家给现代诗谱曲，用 bouzouki 与小型管弦把民间节拍抬进音乐厅，唱腔朴素不炫技，独裁年代里被当成政治宣言来听。
enDesc: Composers setting modern Greek poetry, lifting folk meters into the concert hall with bouzouki and small orchestra; plain singing heard as politics under the junta.

zhDesc: 大学城的男声传统，只穿黑袍在夜里唱给窗口听，葡萄牙吉他的滑音细如丝，不为钱不鼓掌，后来接上了反抗萨拉查的歌。
enDesc: A university men's tradition sung to windows at night in black capes: silken Portuguese guitar runs, no applause, no pay, later turned against Salazar.

whereZh: 西班牙 · 安达卢西亚 · 传统
zhDesc: 弗拉门戈里最沉的几个曲式，siguiriya 与 martinete 几乎不用吉他，只靠喊嗓与铁锤敲拍，一句歌词要唱到嗓子哑掉才算数。
enDesc: The heaviest flamenco forms: siguiriya and martinete need barely any guitar, just a cried-out voice and hammer strokes, one line pushed until the throat frays.

zhDesc: 那不勒斯方言写的城市歌谣，曼陀铃与吉他托着大跨度的旋律，副歌一上就往高处拉，移民把它随船带到纽约的每个街角。
enDesc: City songs in Neapolitan dialect: mandolin and guitar under wide-arching melodies that leap at the refrain, carried to every immigrant street corner in New York.

whereZh: 意大利 · 萨伦托 · 传统
zhDesc: 原是给被毒蛛咬过的女人做疗愈仪式的快速舞曲，铃鼓一路加速不肯停，女声尖利，手风琴与提琴跟着转，跳到人瘫下为止。
enDesc: Fast dance once used to cure women bitten by spiders: a tambourine accelerating without mercy, piercing voices, fiddle and accordion circling until dancers drop.

zhDesc: 七十年代意大利乐队把交响乐、教堂管风琴和歌剧式唱腔塞进长篇组曲，转折比英国同行更急，抒情段落甜得不加掩饰。
enDesc: Seventies Italian bands packing symphonic strings, church organ and operatic singing into long suites: sharper turns than their British peers, unashamedly lush.
key: Premiata Forneria Marconi — Per un Amico

zhDesc: 专供电视台买断使用的成套录音，一线乐手匿名录制，每首都短、直接、只讲一个情绪，标题就叫「紧张追逐」或「都市清晨」。
enDesc: Albums pressed only for broadcasters to license: anonymous top session players cutting short, on-the-nose cues titled things like "Tense Chase" or "City Morning".

zhDesc: 罗马配乐棚的独门配器：口哨、电吉他颤音、马鞭响、女高音无词吟唱与教堂钟声并置，为几乎没有台词的对峙镜头造出全部情绪。
enDesc: Rome's scoring rooms invented a palette of whistling, tremolo guitar, whip cracks, wordless soprano and church bells to carry near-wordless standoffs.

zhDesc: 婚宴上的炫技乐队，单簧管与萨克斯把民间不对称拍吹到极速，中段突然拐进爵士和声，当年因太过出格而被文化部门盯上。
enDesc: Wedding bands playing folk odd meters at impossible speed on clarinet and sax, veering into jazz harmony mid-tune — too wild for the culture ministry.

whereZh: 塞尔维亚与罗马尼亚 · 传统至 1990s
zhDesc: 罗姆人乐队用旧军乐编制吹村里的舞曲，大号一个人当整个节奏组，小号在上面飙到破音，婚礼上绕着人头吹到你掏钱为止。
enDesc: Roma bands playing village dances on old military brass: one tuba as the whole rhythm section, trumpets screaming above, blown at your ear until you pay up.

whereZh: 意大利 · 撒丁岛 · 传统
zhDesc: 四个牧羊人围成一圈，两人用喉音发出粗糙的持续音，像风箱也像羊叫，另两人在上面唱旋律与诗句，和声挤得几乎发涩。
enDesc: Four Sardinian shepherds in a circle: two producing rasping guttural drones like bellows or bleating, two carrying the verse above in bitingly close harmony.

zhDesc: 三声部男声合唱，用的不是西欧律制，于是和弦听着又宽又涩，低音持续不断，上面两声部互相绕行，饭桌上的祝酒歌也这么唱。
enDesc: Three-part male singing outside Western tuning, so the chords ring wide and astringent: a constant bass with two upper voices crossing, sung even as toasts.

zhDesc: 一把走音的木吉他，一个嗓子哑掉的作者，词写得比曲重要，靠私录磁带在厨房与登山队之间传抄，官方唱片厂从不发行。
enDesc: One out-of-tune acoustic guitar and a hoarse author whose words outweigh the tune, circulated on home-taped reels through kitchens, never pressed by the state label.

zhDesc: 把吉他弦调松成开放和弦，拇指弹低音、其余指头摘出旋律与泛音，家族之间各有秘传调法，歌唱起来常带假声翻转。
enDesc: Guitars slackened into open tunings, thumb walking the bass while fingers pick melody and harmonics; tunings kept as family secrets, vocals flipping into falsetto.
key: The Gabby Pahinui Hawaiian Band — Vol. 1

whereZh: 美国 · 南部乡村 · 1800s 起
zhDesc: 会众围成方阵面对面齐唱，四声部各占一边，用形状记谱不用乐器，唱得又响又直，声音撞在木墙上散不开，重在一起唱不在好听。
enDesc: Congregations sing in a hollow square, one voice part per side, reading shaped noteheads with no instruments: loud, blunt singing meant for participants, not listeners.
key: V/A — Rivers of Delight: American Folk Hymns from the Sacred Harp Tradition

zhDesc: 提琴与班卓同奏一条旋律，不像蓝草那样轮流独奏，弓法带着刮擦声，节奏为跳舞而生，一首曲子能不换花样地转上五分钟。
enDesc: Fiddle and banjo playing one melody together rather than trading solos: scratchy bowing, dance-driven rhythm, a tune held for five minutes without variation.

zhDesc: 法语区舞厅的两步与华尔兹，全音阶手风琴与提琴齐头并进，三角铁敲个不停，男声用假声般的高腔硬喊，为的是压过跳舞的脚步声。
enDesc: French-Louisiana two-steps and waltzes: diatonic accordion doubled by fiddle, triangle ringing throughout, vocals pitched high to carry over the dancers' feet.
key: The Balfa Brothers — The Balfa Brothers Play Traditional Cajun Music

whereZh: 美国 · 密西西比北部 · 1960s–90s
zhDesc: 不走十二小节套路的蓝调分支，一个乐句一个和弦就撑满整首，吉他反复推着同一个音型，靠非洲式的鼓点与拍手把人钉在原地摆动。
enDesc: Blues that ignores the twelve-bar form: one riff, one chord, guitar grinding the same figure while drums and hand claps hold dancers in place, swaying.
key: Mississippi Fred McDowell — I Do Not Play No Rock 'n' Roll

zhDesc: 英国北部通宵舞厅挖出来的美国冷门单曲，速度偏快、鼓点顶着四拍猛敲，原唱多半在美国没红过，唱片稀有度本身成了审美。
enDesc: Obscure American soul 45s unearthed for all-nighters in northern England: fast four-on-the-floor stompers that flopped at home, rarity itself becoming the aesthetic.
key: Frank Wilson — "Do I Love You (Indeed I Do)"

zhDesc: 把 house 的四四拍掰成瘸腿的三连音，低音在地下室里闷响，人声只剩一句咒语般的反复，专为德班小巴的车载音响调过音。
enDesc: House bent into a limping triplet stomp: subs booming like a basement, one chanted vocal loop, tuned for Durban taxi sound systems.

zhDesc: 比勒陀利亚黑人城镇的自制 house：廉价键盘敲出跳跃的三音动机，鼓点抢在拍前落地，短促、干燥，配合当地那套抬腿舞步。
enDesc: Township house from Pretoria: cheap-keyboard three-note hooks, drums landing ahead of the beat, dry and short, built around a local high-step dance.

whereZh: 坦桑尼亚 · 达累斯萨拉姆 · 2010s
zhDesc: 达累斯萨拉姆贫民区的极速舞曲，鼓机能跑到每分钟三百拍，采样自 taarab 与老 hip-hop 的碎片被抽成尖锐的短促循环，MC 在上面连珠炮式喊话。
enDesc: Slum-born speed dance from Dar es Salaam past 300 BPM: shards of taarab and old hip-hop cut into shrill loops, MCs rattling on top.

zh: 电子沙比（马赫拉加纳特）
zhDesc: 开罗街区婚礼的音乐进了廉价录音棚：键盘模仿的爆响打击、失真到破音的人声、把 auto-tune 当乐器用，歌词直接骂物价与警察。
enDesc: Cairo street-wedding music through a cheap studio: blown-out keyboard percussion, vocals distorted past clipping, auto-tune as an instrument, lyrics about rent and cops.

zhDesc: 罗安达的硬派电子舞曲：semba 的切分节奏塞进廉价软件，鼓组硬得像敲铁皮，喊麦短句循环推进，跳的人靠肩膀和膝盖发力。
enDesc: Hard electronic dance from Luanda: semba syncopation rebuilt in cheap software, tin-hard drums, shouted refrains, danced from the shoulders and knees.

zhDesc: 圣保罗贫民区 funk 的极端分支：低音被推成一团失真的黑影，节奏碎成不规则的跺脚，人声采样倒放、拉长，故意做出邪门恐怖片的气味。
enDesc: The extreme edge of São Paulo favela funk: bass shoved into distorted black smoke, rhythms broken into irregular stomps, vocals reversed for horror-film menace.

zhDesc: 里约山城派对上不进电台的那一批 funk：只有一台鼓机的 tamborzão 节奏、街头帮派的实况唱词，录音糙得像现场翻录的磁带。
enDesc: The Rio hillside funk radio wouldn't touch: bare tamborzão drum-machine pattern, gang reportage as lyrics, sound quality of a party tape dubbed twice.
key: V/A — Rio Baile Funk: Favela Booty Beats

whereZh: 多米尼加 · 圣多明各 · 2000s–10s
zhDesc: 把牙买加 riddim 那一记「哒-哒-哒」抽出来无限循环，配上尖细的电子口哨与喊话式说唱，节奏快、句子短、几乎不留呼吸的空隙。
enDesc: One Jamaican riddim kick pattern looped forever, topped with shrill synth whistles and shouted raps — fast, clipped, barely a gap to breathe.

zhDesc: 把 house 的速度拖慢到走路的节奏，贝斯线肥厚，人声用祖鲁语与街头俚语半唱半说——种族隔离结束那几年南非城镇的派对声。
enDesc: House slowed to walking pace with fat bass lines and half-sung Zulu street slang — the sound of township parties in the years apartheid ended.

zhDesc: amapiano 里安静讲究的那一支：log drum 的滑音留足空隙，爵士味的电钢与人声碎片飘着，速度不快，冷静得像凌晨四点的车厢。
enDesc: The quiet, fastidious branch of amapiano: sliding log drums with air around them, jazzy electric piano, vocal shards, calm as a 4 a.m. car ride.
key: Kabza De Small & DJ Maphorisa — Scorpion Kings

zhDesc: 八拍一个循环的破碎鼓组，永远躲不开那两句采样（Lyn Collins 的尖叫与 Gaz 的鼓点），人声只用来喊口令，专门服务舞池上的斗舞。
enDesc: Broken eight-bar loops built on two inescapable samples, vocals reduced to shouted commands — engineered for dance battles on a crowded floor.

zhDesc: 160 拍上下的机械三连音，低音闷成一记记拳，同一句人声被剁成十几段抽风般重复——为舞者脚下的对拼而写，不为坐着听。
enDesc: Machine triplets around 160 BPM, bass landing like body blows, one vocal chopped into a dozen stuttering pieces — written for dancers' feet, not for sitting.

zhDesc: 底特律把 techno、electro 和 Miami bass 拌进一台鼓机，速度推到 150 拍以上，混音只留骨架，DJ 靠急促的切歌把整晚拉着往前跑。
enDesc: Detroit stirring techno, electro and Miami bass into one drum machine past 150 BPM, mixes stripped to bone, DJs cutting tracks every ninety seconds.

zhDesc: 芝加哥 Dance Mania 一系的极简 house：909 的底鼓、一根循环贝斯、一句反复的口号，粗糙、便宜、直奔跳舞这一件事。
enDesc: Minimal house from Chicago's Dance Mania stable: a 909 kick, one looping bass, one repeated chant — cheap, coarse, aimed squarely at dancing.
key: V/A — Hardcore Traxx: Dance Mania Records 1986–1997

zhDesc: 两段固定采样（Triggerman 与 Brown Beat）撑起整个流派，MC 用点名的方式喊街区与人名，节奏永远保持在能连续摇臀的那个速度。
enDesc: A whole genre built on two fixed samples, with MCs calling out wards and names over a beat locked at the tempo you can keep shaking to.

zhDesc: 808 的低音被推到音箱纸盆发抖，速度快、鼓点脆，主角不是旋律而是那条能把后备箱震开的次低频。
enDesc: 808 bass pushed until the cone flaps, fast and crisp on top; the hook isn't a melody but the sub that rattles a car trunk open.
key: Dynamix II — "Just Give the DJ a Break"

zhDesc: 伦敦把 soca 与非洲手鼓的碎拍搭在 house 的骨架上，低音克制，主唱唱情歌，节奏却一直在侧面挠人。
enDesc: London laying soca and West African hand-drum patterns over a house frame: restrained bass, a love-song vocal, rhythm nudging sideways throughout.

zhDesc: 从 speed garage 长出来的北方分支：一根弹簧似的方波贝斯扛起全曲，R&B 女声在上面唱，四四拍稳到可以踩着走。
enDesc: The northern offshoot of speed garage: one springy square-wave bass carrying everything, an R&B vocal above, four-four steady enough to march to.

zhDesc: 把纽约 house 提速，塞进 jungle 那种翻滚的低音与雷鬼式的 MC 喊场，军鼓打在意料之外的地方，是英国车库乐最躁的那一版。
enDesc: New York house sped up and fitted with jungle's rolling bass and ragga MC hype, snares landing off-expectation — UK garage at its rowdiest.

whereZh: 英国 · 东伦敦 · 2000s 初
zhDesc: grime 最初的骨架：廉价软件里冷冰冰的方波与钟琴音色，八拍一循环，空得只剩节奏与寒气，为 MC 的连珠炮腾出全部空间。
enDesc: Grime's original skeleton: icy square waves and bell tones from cheap software, eight-bar loops left almost empty so the MC can fill them.

zhDesc: 把 grime 的低音整条抽掉，只留下金属敲击、气流与远处的合成器长音，节奏悬在半空，像在空旷停车场里听一场没有低频的舞会。
enDesc: Grime with the bass removed entirely: metallic hits, air and distant synth pads, the rhythm suspended — a dance in an empty car park.

zhDesc: 2-step 的碎拍泡在混响里，人声被拉高变调、剪成叹息，低频温和地压着，整体像隔着雨夜的窗户听一支旧派对。
enDesc: 2-step shuffle soaked in reverb, vocals pitched up and cut into sighs, bass pressing gently — an old rave heard through a rainy window.

zhDesc: 把舞曲拆成零件再故意装不回去：金属撞击、玻璃碎裂、突然的静默与失控的低音，好听与不适之间反复试探。
enDesc: Dance music taken apart and deliberately misassembled: metal impacts, shattering glass, sudden silence and unstable bass, testing the line between pleasure and unease.

whereZh: 英国 · 布里斯托与伦敦 · 2010s
zhDesc: 去掉旋律，只留手鼓、木块与金属击打排成的循环，130 拍上下，空间开阔而干燥，像把全球打击乐塞进极简 techno 的骨架。
enDesc: Melody removed, leaving loops of hand drums, woodblocks and metal hits around 130 BPM — global percussion in a minimal techno frame.

zhDesc: 一记和弦通过磁带回声无限衰减，底鼓像远处的心跳，全曲十分钟只发生一点点变化，听的是空气与噪底的厚度。
enDesc: One chord decaying through tape echo forever, a kick like a distant heartbeat, ten minutes where almost nothing changes but the thickness of the air.

zhDesc: 用几百个几毫秒的碎片拼出摇摆：咳嗽声、开关声、唱片噪音都成了打击乐，house 的律动还在，材料却全换成生活噪音。
enDesc: Groove assembled from hundreds of millisecond fragments — coughs, switches, vinyl noise as percussion — house swing built from household sound.

zhDesc: 把 techno 推进红区：底鼓过载失真、金属反馈当旋律用、混响像水泥厂房，四四拍在噪音里硬撑住秩序。
enDesc: Techno pushed into the red: overloaded kicks, metal feedback used as melody, concrete-hall reverb, four-four holding order inside the noise.
key: Perc — The Power and the Glory

zhDesc: 底特律的摇摆感配上更硬的鼓：手鼓与 hi-hat 层层叠加成不断打滚的律动，速度不快却停不下来，DJ 常三台盘一起推。
enDesc: Detroit swing with harder drums: congas and hats stacked into a rolling groove that never lets up, usually mixed three decks at a time.

zhDesc: 德国硬派 techno：一段砂纸质地的循环 loop 从头刮到尾，底鼓密不透风，靠效果器扫频推动，属于凌晨四点的大棚。
enDesc: German hard techno: one sandpaper loop scraping start to finish over an airtight kick, driven by filter sweeps — 4 a.m. warehouse fare.

zhDesc: 无照野派对的音乐：底鼓打满、酸线扭到尖叫、采样来自政治广播与老电影，为了发电机与卡车音响而写，不为俱乐部。
enDesc: Music for unlicensed outdoor raves: relentless kicks, acid lines screwed to a scream, samples off political broadcasts — made for generators and truck rigs.

zhDesc: 鹿特丹对阿姆斯特丹 house 的回击：底鼓压成一记记失真的闷响，速度冲到 190 拍，采样越粗野越好，配合原地跳跺的舞步。
enDesc: Rotterdam's answer to Amsterdam house: kicks distorted into blunt thuds, tempos to 190 BPM, samples as crude as possible, danced on the spot.

zhDesc: 从自由派对长出来的极速硬核：200 拍上下的滚动底鼓、断头式的采样切换，比荷兰派更神经质、更爱突然掉进静音。
enDesc: Speed hardcore out of the free-party scene: rolling kicks near 200 BPM, guillotine sample edits, more neurotic than the Dutch strain and fond of sudden silence.

zhDesc: 把硬核推到 200 拍以上，底鼓被压缩成尖锐的一记「叮」，旋律部分反而写得像庆典号角，暴力与欢腾同时拉满。
enDesc: Hardcore past 200 BPM with kicks compressed into a sharp ping, while the melodies turn festival-bright — violence and elation at once.

zhDesc: 170 拍的碎拍配上加速的女声与糖分过量的钢琴 riff，天真到近乎悲伤——英国锐舞退潮后留在青少年迪斯科里的那一支。
enDesc: 170 BPM breaks under sped-up female vocals and sugar-overloaded piano riffs, so naive it turns sad — what stayed in teen discos after the rave ebbed.

zhDesc: 锐舞的欢快被抽掉之后剩下的东西：加速的碎拍、恐怖片弦乐、低到发闷的贝斯，采样里全是警笛与不安的对白。
enDesc: What was left when rave's euphoria drained out: accelerated breaks, horror-film strings, bass sunk to a muffle, samples of sirens and uneasy dialogue.

zhDesc: 把 drum & bass 的暖意换成金属：贝斯像液压机的呼吸，鼓组干硬、无摇摆，整体是科幻片工厂内部的声音。
enDesc: Drum & bass with the warmth swapped for metal: bass breathing like hydraulics, drums dry and swingless — the inside of a sci-fi factory.

zhDesc: techstep 之后的精密化版本：贝斯被调制成不断变形的机械嗓音，每一小节都在换音色，制作精度高到像在听工程演示。
enDesc: The precision-engineered descendant of techstep: bass modulated into a shifting mechanical voice, timbre changing every bar, produced like an engineering demo.

zhDesc: 把牙买加 dancehall 的唱段贴到加速碎拍上，低音走 dub 的路线，鼓组翻滚得像散架的机器，是英国黑人锐舞最直接的一支。
enDesc: Jamaican dancehall vocals pasted onto accelerated breaks with dub bass underneath, drums rolling like a machine coming apart.

zhDesc: 把 amen break 剁到分子级别再重排，密度高到接近噪音，中间却常插进古典弦乐或民谣采样，暴力与伤感贴在一起。
enDesc: The amen break diced to molecules and rebuilt at near-noise density, then cut with classical strings or folk samples — violence pressed against grief.
key: Venetian Snares — Rossz Csillag Alatt Született

zhDesc: 为林间派对写的迷幻电子：低音线像虫群移动，音色潮湿、有机，声场里满是拟真的鸟叫与滴水，气氛偏诡异而非狂欢。
enDesc: Psychedelic trance for woodland parties: bass lines moving like insect swarms, damp organic timbres, birdcalls and dripping water — eerie rather than euphoric.

whereZh: 德国与俄罗斯 · 1990s 末起
zhDesc: 速度推到 160 拍以上的迷幻电子，采样取自恐怖片与生化实验，音色刺耳、结构扭曲，听感更接近噩梦而不是舞池。
enDesc: Psytrance past 160 BPM with horror-film and lab-experiment samples, harsh timbres and warped structures — closer to a nightmare than a dancefloor.

whereZh: 罗马尼亚 · 布加勒斯特 · 2010s
zhDesc: 布加勒斯特那派极简 house：低音只走几个音，细碎的打击乐在立体声里绕圈，一首曲子十几分钟只慢慢改变一点点。
enDesc: Bucharest's minimal house: bass reduced to a few notes, tiny percussion circling in stereo, a track shifting only fractionally across fifteen minutes.

zhDesc: 808 的机械切分配上水下感的和声与变声人声，主题常是逃亡、深海与未来神话，冷、快、带着叙事。
enDesc: 808 machine syncopation under submarine harmonies and vocoded voices, themed on escape, deep water and future myth — cold, fast, narrative.

zhDesc: 把 electro 与 Italo disco 的廉价浪漫混在一起，模拟合成器调得刺耳发糙，态度反商业到近乎挑衅。
enDesc: Electro crossed with the cheap romance of Italo disco, analogue synths tuned harsh and grainy, an anti-commercial stance bordering on provocation.

zhDesc: 把 Miami bass 的低音接到碎拍上，节奏摇摆而不冲，中段留出长长的滤波推进，是九十年代美国 club 里最好跳的一支。
enDesc: Miami bass low end welded to breakbeats: swinging rather than driving, long filtered build-ups — the most danceable strain in 1990s US clubs.

whereZh: 德国 · 法兰克福 · 1990s 末
zhDesc: 故意把数字故障当素材：爆音、断点、CD 跳针被排成节奏，旋律近乎不存在，听的是错误本身的质感。
enDesc: Digital failure used as material: clipping, dropouts and CD skips arranged into rhythm, melody nearly absent — the texture of error itself.

zhDesc: 把几乎听不见的声音放大成整张专辑：纸张摩擦、蜡烛燃烧、细微的电流嗡鸣，需要把音量拧大才开始出现内容。
enDesc: Barely audible sound amplified into whole albums — paper friction, a burning candle, faint current hum — content that only appears once you turn it up.

zhDesc: 用无输入调音台、反馈与静默即兴：声音稀薄、留白极长，两个演奏者常十几秒才各出一声，听的是房间与耳朵的关系。
enDesc: Improvising with no-input mixers, feedback and silence: sparse events, enormous gaps, two players sounding once every ten seconds — a music about rooms and ears.

zhDesc: 一整面不变的静态噪音从第一秒挂到最后一秒，没有动态、没有事件，纪律严格到近乎极简主义的一个恶作剧。
enDesc: One unchanging slab of static from first second to last: no dynamics, no events — a discipline so strict it verges on minimalist prank.

zhDesc: 没有节奏与旋律，只有失控的合成器高频与嘶喊，音量与压迫感就是全部结构，现场比录音更难承受。
enDesc: No rhythm, no melody — runaway synth treble and screamed vocals, with volume and pressure as the only structure; live it is harder to take than on record.

zhDesc: 低频轰鸣、金属废料的回响与含混的呻吟层层堆叠，节奏几近停滞，像在废弃工厂的地下室里缓慢下沉。
enDesc: Low-frequency rumble, scrap-metal reverb and muffled groans stacked into near-static slabs — sinking slowly in an abandoned factory basement.

zhDesc: 把效果器链推到彻底饱和，全频段同时爆发，没有段落也没有休止，几十年下来发展出各自可辨的「噪音笔迹」。
enDesc: Effect chains driven to total saturation, all frequencies erupting at once with no sections or rests — decades in, each artist has a recognisable noise handwriting.

zhDesc: 用旧教育片配乐、公共电视片头与磁带噪音重造一个从未存在过的英国童年，音色发霉、剪辑跳接，怀旧得让人不安。
enDesc: Old educational-film scores, public-TV idents and tape hiss rebuilt into a British childhood that never happened — mouldy timbres, jump-cut edits, nostalgia turned uneasy.
key: The Focus Group — Hey Let Loose Your Love

zhDesc: 只用别人的录音当材料：把一首名曲逐帧拆开重排，原曲还认得出来，意义却被彻底改写，也因此吃过唱片公司的官司。
enDesc: Built only from other people's recordings: a famous track dismantled frame by frame and reassembled — recognisable, meaning rewritten, and duly sued over.

zhDesc: 在 Game Boy 里用 LSDJ 写曲：四条音轨、方波与噪音通道，限制逼出旋律功力，现场就是一台掌机接进 PA。
enDesc: Composed inside a Game Boy with LSDJ: four channels of square waves and noise, limits forcing melodic craft, performed with a handheld plugged into the PA.

zhDesc: 为电脑演示程序写的音乐，用采样表与追踪器逐格排好，容量常被压到几十 KB，旋律因此写得极为紧凑抓耳。
enDesc: Written for computer demos in trackers, cell by cell, often squeezed into a few dozen kilobytes — which is why the melodies are so tightly hooked.

zhDesc: Buchla 一脉的思路：不按键盘、不追音准，用随机源与复杂振荡器让声音自己长出形状，结果常在旋律与鸟叫之间。
enDesc: The Buchla lineage: no keyboard, no fixed pitch — random sources and complex oscillators letting sound grow its own shape, landing between melody and birdsong.

zhDesc: 把 hip-hop 的采样手法用在氛围音乐上：迟缓的鼓、厚重的低音雾、城市噪音与短波电台混在一起，听着像纽约夏夜的地铁风口。
enDesc: Hip-hop sampling applied to ambient: sluggish drums, thick bass fog, street noise and shortwave radio — a New York subway vent in summer.
key: DJ Spooky — Songs of a Dead Dreamer

zhDesc: 用最廉价的键盘音色摹写中世纪与幻想地牢：单薄的弦乐预设、缓慢的进行曲、磁带噪音，业余感恰恰是它的魅力。
enDesc: Medieval fantasy dungeons sketched on the cheapest keyboard presets: thin string patches, slow marches, tape hiss — the amateurism is the charm.

zhDesc: dungeon synth 的雪原分支：长长的合成弦乐铺成白色平面，风声与铃声偶尔穿过，气温感比旋律更重要。
enDesc: The snowfield branch of dungeon synth: long synth strings spread into white planes, wind and bells passing through — temperature matters more than melody.
key: Old Sorcery — Realms of Magickal Sorrow

zhDesc: 以低频轰鸣为地基，叠上远处的诵经、金属碰撞与洞穴混响，几乎没有节奏，像在一座空教堂里等着什么发生。
enDesc: Low-frequency drone as foundation with distant chanting, struck metal and cave reverb, almost rhythmless — waiting for something in an empty church.

zhDesc: 九十年代对「舒适氛围」的反面：冷、空、带工业锈味的长音，没有旋律安慰，只有距离感与低温。
enDesc: The 1990s counter to comfortable ambient: cold, empty, rust-tinged drones with no melodic comfort — only distance and low temperature.

zhDesc: 把金属乐的失真拉成极慢的长音，一个和弦能撑几分钟，鼓几乎不出现，靠音量与泛音的堆叠制造压强。
enDesc: Metal distortion stretched into extremely slow drones, one chord held for minutes, drums nearly absent — pressure built from volume and overtones.

zhDesc: 速度慢到接近停止，和弦像挽歌一样一记记落下，人声在深处低吼，一首曲子往往十几分钟只走完一段旋律。
enDesc: Slowed almost to a halt, chords falling like a dirge, vocals growling from far below — fifteen minutes to complete one melodic line.

whereZh: 澳大利亚与英国 · 1990s 初
zhDesc: 死亡金属的重量配上末日金属的速度：段落在极慢与突然加速之间切换，气氛沉重、混音刻意浑浊。
enDesc: Death metal's weight at doom's tempo, sections lurching between crawl and sudden acceleration, mixes deliberately murky.

zhDesc: 把黑金属的和声全部拧歪：不解决的音程、爬行式的吉他线、突然的静默段落，结构像一篇故意写乱的神学论文。
enDesc: Black metal with the harmony wrenched out of true: unresolving intervals, crawling guitar lines, abrupt silences — structured like a deliberately deranged theological text.
key: Deathspell Omega — Fas – Ite, Maledicti, in Ignem Aeternum

zhDesc: 把 shoegaze 的混响墙接到黑金属的连奏鼓上：嘶喊被埋在吉他的洪流下面，听感明亮又悲伤，像在雪地里跑。
enDesc: Shoegaze reverb walls welded to black metal blast beats: screams buried under a guitar flood, bright and grieving at once — running through snow.

zhDesc: 刻意把录音做成一团轰鸣：鼓像雪崩、吉他辨不清和弦、人声在底下咆哮，追求的是失控而不是清晰。
enDesc: Recording deliberately reduced to one avalanche: drums as landslide, chords indecipherable, vocals bellowing underneath — chaos preferred over clarity.

zhDesc: 把重型 riff 拉长成十分钟的地质运动，中间插入部落式打击与安静段落，音量与情绪一起缓慢积累到崩塌。
enDesc: Heavy riffs stretched into ten-minute geological movements with tribal percussion and quiet passages, volume and feeling accumulating until collapse.

whereZh: 美国 · 新泽西 · 1990s 末
zhDesc: 把 hardcore 的暴力拆进变态拍号：每两秒换一次节奏、吉他线像被扯断的电缆，演奏精度和噪音量同时拉到极限。
enDesc: Hardcore violence broken across deranged time signatures: the meter shifting every two seconds, guitar lines like snapped cable, precision and noise maxed together.
key: The Dillinger Escape Plan — Calculating Infinity

zhDesc: 把 hardcore 压到三十秒一首：极快的段落突然掉进泥浆般的慢速，再突然结束，专辑一面能塞进二十首。
enDesc: Hardcore compressed to thirty seconds a song: blistering bursts dropping into sludge tempo and cutting off — twenty tracks a side.
key: Man Is the Bastard — Sum of the Whole

zhDesc: grindcore 里最朴素的一支：录音粗糙、riff 简单重复、歌词直白反战反资本，几十年如一日地自印磁带交换。
enDesc: The plainest branch of grindcore: raw recordings, simple repeated riffs, blunt anti-war lyrics, and decades of self-dubbed tape trading.

zhDesc: 把编程鼓机塞进 grindcore：鼓点快到不像人类，合成器与故障音效贴在失真吉他上，段落切换像换台。
enDesc: Programmed drums inside grindcore: beats too fast to be human, synths and glitch effects pasted onto distorted guitar, sections switching like channels.

zhDesc: 情绪硬核里最失控的一支：嗓子喊到破音、编曲在混乱与突然的清亮之间反复摔，录音多是地下室现场质感。
enDesc: The most unravelled strain of emotional hardcore: voices screamed past breaking, arrangements lurching between chaos and sudden clarity, recorded in basements.

zhDesc: 把车库朋克的速度配上廉价合成器与变调怪腔，编曲神经兮兮、录音故意做薄，网络场景里自己起的绰号。
enDesc: Garage punk speed with cheap synths and pitched-up yelping, arrangements twitchy and recordings deliberately thin — a nickname the net scene gave itself.
key: Lumpy and the Dumpers — Huff My Sack

whereZh: 欧美各地 · 1970s 末–80s 初
zhDesc: 由一套地下合辑定义的类别：小镇乐队自费压的单曲，两分钟、跑调、录音爆掉，反而成了朋克最生猛的一批文献。
enDesc: A category defined by one bootleg compilation series: self-pressed small-town singles, two minutes, out of tune, blown-out — punk's rawest paperwork.

zhDesc: 整支流派建立在一种鼓型上：Discharge 那记不断滚动的军鼓，吉他只用两三个和弦，歌词全是核战与末日。
enDesc: A whole genre built on one drum pattern — Discharge's rolling snare — with two or three chords and lyrics of nuclear war and aftermath.
key: Anti Cimex — Victims of a Bomb Raid

zhDesc: 把朋克当成政治工具：拼贴式的唱片封套、拒绝商业发行、歌词直指战争与体制，音乐粗砺而结构常常出人意料。
enDesc: Punk as political tool: collaged sleeves, refusal of commercial release, lyrics aimed at war and the state, music raw but structurally unpredictable.

whereZh: 美国 · 奥林匹亚 · 1990s 初
zhDesc: 西北部女性主导的朋克浪潮：三分钟一首、结构直白、嗓音在唱与喊之间切换，同人小志与演出现场同等重要。
enDesc: A women-led punk wave from the Pacific Northwest: three-minute songs, plain structures, voices flipping between singing and shouting — zines as vital as gigs.

zhDesc: 从同人小志长出来的朋克分支，歌词直面性向与身份政治，编曲经常带甜的旋律，与硬核场景既并肩又对抗。
enDesc: A punk branch grown out of zines, lyrics facing sexuality and identity head-on, often with sweet melodies — alongside the hardcore scene and against it.

zhDesc: 彻底否掉摇滚语法：吉他调成非常规音、萨克斯乱吹、节奏刻意生硬，短暫却把后来的噪音摇滚全部预告完了。
enDesc: Rock grammar refused outright: guitars in invented tunings, saxophones flailing, rhythms deliberately stiff — brief, and it forecast everything noisy that followed.

zhDesc: 无浪潮的人去跳舞：迪斯科的律动混进朋克的态度、拉丁打击与荒腔走板的唱腔，怪、扭、但极其好跳。
enDesc: The no wave crowd going dancing: disco groove crossed with punk attitude, Latin percussion and off-key singing — crooked and extremely danceable.
key: V/A — Mutant Disco: A Subtle Discolation of the Norm

zhDesc: 欧陆版的 post-punk：鼓机机械地走、贝斯冰冷、法语人声低沉平铺，情绪压抑到几乎不起伏。
enDesc: The continental take on post-punk: drum machines ticking, bass icy, French vocals low and level, emotion pressed almost flat.

zhDesc: 卧室里用一台单音合成器和一台鼓机做出的 synth-pop：编曲只剩三层，磁带发行量常常只有几十份，二十年后才被挖出来。
enDesc: Bedroom synth-pop from one monosynth and a drum machine: three layers at most, cassette runs of a few dozen, unearthed twenty years later.
key: V/A — The Minimal Wave Tapes Volume One

zhDesc: 把 chopped and screwed 的减速手法用在暗色电子上：人声降调发闷、鼓机迟缓、混响厚重，视觉与音乐一起走神秘学路线。
enDesc: Chopped-and-screwed slowing applied to dark electronics: vocals pitched down and muffled, sluggish drum machines, heavy reverb, occult imagery to match.

whereZh: 美国 · 奥克兰与网络 · 2010s 初
zhDesc: beat 由飘忽的合成器与失焦采样铺成，鼓点轻、混音朦胧，说唱像在半梦里自言自语，最早靠 SoundCloud 与博客扩散。
enDesc: Beats of hazy synths and out-of-focus samples, light drums and blurred mixes, rapping half-dreamt aloud — spread first by SoundCloud and blogs.

zhDesc: 自录磁带上的低保真说唱：808 闷响、阴森的合成器循环、双声道都糊在一起，日后被 phonk 整批挖出来当母本。
enDesc: Lo-fi rap off self-dubbed cassettes: muffled 808s, sinister synth loops, both channels smeared together — later mined wholesale as phonk's source material.
key: Tommy Wright III — On the Run

zhDesc: 把孟菲斯磁带采样接上失真到爆的 cowbell 与超饱和 808，节奏直冲，配着漂移赛车视频在短视频平台上疯长。
enDesc: Memphis tape samples wired to blown-out cowbells and oversaturated 808s, driving straight ahead — grown huge on short-video platforms beside drift-car footage.

zhDesc: 把整张唱片放慢到六成速度再手动跳针重复：人声变成低沉的拖长句，时间被拉开，专为休斯顿的车内慢驾而生。
enDesc: Whole records slowed to about 60 percent and hand-skipped into repeats: voices dragged low, time pulled apart — made for slow driving in Houston.

zhDesc: trap 的鼓组配上失真吉他与嘶喊：结构还是说唱，能量与录音质感来自 hardcore，人声常整段推到破音。
enDesc: Trap drums under distorted guitar and screaming: rap structure with hardcore energy and mixing, vocals routinely pushed past clipping.

zhDesc: 把芝加哥 drill 的阴郁搬到伦敦，鼓组换成滑音低音与 140 拍的 hi-hat 碎步，唱腔冷淡、押韵密，气氛紧到发闷。
enDesc: Chicago drill's gloom moved to London: sliding bass and 140 BPM hat shuffles, delivery deadpan, rhymes dense, atmosphere airless.

whereZh: 美国 · 芝加哥南区 · 2010s 初
zhDesc: 慢速 trap 的骨架配上单调阴冷的合成器，说唱平铺直叙地讲街区实况，混音干、留白多，几乎不做任何修饰。
enDesc: Slow trap frames under monotone icy synths, rapping reporting the block flatly, mixes dry and sparse with almost no ornament.

zhDesc: 湾区的派对说唱：贝斯线弹跳、节奏偏快、喊话式副歌，一切为了车队聚会与「去傻」那种放开的状态。
enDesc: Bay Area party rap: springy bass lines, quick tempos, shouted hooks — all aimed at sideshows and the license to act foolish.

whereZh: 美国 · 洛杉矶 · 2000s 末
zhDesc: 为一套舞步写的青少年说唱：合成器简单跳跃、鼓点轻脆、速度偏快，最早靠 YouTube 的舞蹈视频在校园里传开。
enDesc: Teen rap written for one dance: simple bouncing synths, light crisp drums, quick tempo — spread through YouTube dance clips.

zhDesc: 受采样机内存所限，每段采样只有几秒：爵士唱片被切成极短的循环，12 位量化把声音磨出砂纸感，鼓点压得又闷又厚。
enDesc: Sampler memory capped each grab at a few seconds: jazz records cut into tiny loops, 12-bit quantisation sanding the sound, drums thick and muffled.

zhDesc: beat 用工业噪音、无调打击与静默做成，说唱在其中保持精确的节奏感，题材常带政治与叙事野心。
enDesc: Beats built from industrial noise, atonal percussion and silence, with rapping holding precise time — and lyrics carrying political and narrative ambition.

zhDesc: vaporwave 里最空旷的一支：把商场背景乐拉长、加满混响，人声与旋律都退到很远，只剩下空调声与走廊的回音。
enDesc: Vaporwave's emptiest branch: mall muzak stretched and drowned in reverb, melody receding until only air conditioning and corridor echo remain.
key: 猫 シ Corp. — Palm Mall

zhDesc: 把日本 city pop 与 disco 的片段切成四四拍的循环，加滤波、提速，配上老动画画面，是 vaporwave 里最欢快的一支。
enDesc: Japanese city pop and disco chopped into four-four loops, filtered and sped up, paired with old anime footage — vaporwave's cheerful cousin.

zhDesc: 把流行歌片段以每几秒一次的频率互相撞在一起，jersey club 的鼓型撑底，密度大到像刷短视频时的注意力本身。
enDesc: Pop fragments crashed into each other every few seconds over jersey club drums — density that mimics the attention span it was made for.

zhDesc: 在卧室里用破解软件做的 hyperpop 分支：吉他采样、失真 808、auto-tune 全部推到红线，情绪直白得像日记。
enDesc: A hyperpop branch made in bedrooms on cracked software: guitar samples, distorted 808s and auto-tune all in the red, feelings as plain as a diary.

zhDesc: 起初只是两个高中生把 trance 提速变调做成的混音集，人声变尖、节奏变急，二十年后成了整个网络的加速美学源头。
enDesc: It began as two high-schoolers speeding up and pitching trance mixes; twenty years on, that squeaked, hurried sound is the internet's sped-up aesthetic.

zhDesc: 用第四代翻录磁带的音质重写八十年代电台流行：旋律记得住，音源全是霉味，像在别人记忆里听一首没听过的老歌。
enDesc: 1980s radio pop rewritten at fourth-generation cassette quality: hummable tunes made of mould — an unheard oldie inside someone else's memory.
key: Ariel Pink's Haunted Graffiti — The Doldrums

zhDesc: 把流行旋律埋在爆掉的四轨录音里：吉他全是毛刺、人声隔着一层墙，越难听清越显得亲密。
enDesc: Pop melodies buried in blown-out four-track recordings: guitars all burr, vocals behind a wall — the harder to make out, the more intimate.

zhDesc: beat 只留两样东西：一条像电锯的合成器与压到失真的 808，说唱把词咬碎成情绪，现场以推挤起跳为默认反应。
enDesc: Beats keep two things — a chainsaw synth and 808s pushed to distortion — while the rapping breaks words into pure affect; moshing is the default response.

whereZh: 美国 · 洛杉矶 · 2000s 末
zhDesc: 刻意把量化关掉：鼓点前后打晃、贝斯音准微微飘，整首听着像喝醉的 hip-hop，源头是洛杉矶的 Low End Theory 夜。
enDesc: Quantisation switched off on purpose: drums wobbling around the grid, bass pitch drifting — drunk hip-hop, born at LA's Low End Theory nights.
